assumptions.grant: All1000 accounts receive20 at enrollment. Existing grant/fees/allocations and deployed zero-cap behavior are unchanged.
assumptions.policy: Commit min(50% prior closed-season reviewed burn, max(0,2*cumulative reviewed burn-all gross claims)). Allocated weekly boss remains equal regardless of personal spending. Future burns are never borrowed.
assumptions.liabilities: No signed carry-over claims or new tester arrivals in this closed-cohort model. Every allocated seasonal promise is charged before its first payment. Unused unsigned requests expire at season close. Offline live planner additionally reserves disjoint outstanding liabilities and planned tester slots.
assumptions.funding: Hypothetical funded allocation envelope, not the current live pool. Actual pool/nonce/source/rules evidence still required by the planner.
assumptions.behavior: Interest50% in each finite catalog is assumed, not measured. Three lifetime styles/forge outputs, same wallet budget and fixed three disjoint seeds for both policies. Bot labels are an optimistic model oracle.
assumptions.source: Conditional campaign applies measured drop functions to assumed successful routes. Style-only environment has no campaign item issuance or forge input. Neither is a human pilot.
assumptions.acceptance: Original gross claims/burn<=2 retained. Unsafe budgets, quiet tails, seasonal health and affordability reported separately; a blocked zero reward is not proof of a healthy economy.
